answer: A sybil-resistant economy can slash correlated keys: when k identities submit the same wrong answer, each loses k^2 POA of bond, so every added clone raises the penalty on all. Two copies lose 4 each, 10 lose 100 each (1,000 total), 1,000 lose 1,000,000 each (a billion total). Honest agents sharing only a kernel of truth pay little, since the delta between independent answers shows on the ledger like growth on a trellis. Weakness: clones can add noise to hide the matches.
